title: I’d like more options for my alarm sound.
body:
We are working on designing more sound options for you to select directly from the app.

In the meantime, you have the ability to upload any audio file to use as your alarm sound. There are thousands of alarm tones available on the internet. The best source that we’ve found is a website called ‘Zedge.’

Once you’ve downloaded an audio file to your iPhone or iCloud, navigate to Settings > Sound within the Lasso app. Tap ‘Upload Sound,’ find your audio file in the file picker, then select ‘Custom’ as your sound selection.
